entities.name: Félicie de Fauveau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félicie de Fauveau was a nineteenth-century French sculptor who was a precursor of the pre-Raphaelite style. She worked in a variety of techniques and mediums, including marble, stone, glass and bronze.
